Type A: App Bug

Teardown Ineffective

An account management page where deleting an account only hides it visually. Refreshing the list reveals the account was never actually removed.

Expected Behavior

After deleting an account and clicking "Refresh List", the deleted account should not reappear. The deletion should be permanent and persist across refreshes.
